## Main sections

- [Home](https://cesarnogueira.tech/): Identity, live capability matrix, experience timeline, engineering galaxy, certifications, testimonials.

## Case studies

- [Enterprise FinOps Automation](https://cesarnogueira.tech/case-studies/finops-automation): Cut ~30% of cloud waste for a global staffing leader — automated tagging, chargeback and executive cost visibility across GCP, AWS and Azure.
- [Big Data Analytics Platform](https://cesarnogueira.tech/case-studies/bigdata-platform): 10× analytics throughput for a US media corporation — self-serve, real-time BigQuery analytics via Apache Beam / Dataflow.
- [Multi-Cloud for Banking & Aviation](https://cesarnogueira.tech/case-studies/banking-cloud): 99.9% availability for AndBank, Santander and LATAM Airlines — secure, observable, regulator-ready cloud across GCP, AWS, Azure and OCI.

## Proof points

- 10+ years in cloud, across GCP, AWS, Azure and OCI.
- 40+ cloud projects delivered.
- 5 certifications: 2× Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect, Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer, AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900).
- ~30% average cloud waste removed on FinOps engagements.
- Clients include AndBank, Santander, LATAM Airlines, Randstad, Accenture, NTT Data, CI&T.
